story.title: Robert Pattinson Announced as the New James Bond
story.summary: Robert Pattinson has been officially named as the next James Bond, succeeding Daniel Craig in the iconic role. This announcement by Amazon MGM Studios ends years of speculation regarding the future of the franchise following Craig's departure after five films. Pattinson, known for his roles in major franchises such as 'The Batman', 'Harry Potter', and 'Twilight', is set to become the seventh actor to portray the legendary spy.

explore_lenses.label: Why is this a pivotal Bond casting?
explore_lenses.title: Amazon’s first 007 choice
explore_lenses.summary: The casting is significant because it is the first new-Bond decision made after Amazon MGM Studios assumed creative control of the franchise. It also completes the core creative team for a film intended to launch the post-Daniel Craig era.

claims.text: Amazon MGM Studios gained creative control of future Bond productions through a joint venture that closed in March 2025; Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson remained co-owners of the franchise rights.
The next film pairs Pattinson with director Denis Villeneuve, writer Steven Knight, producers Amy Pascal and David Heyman, and executive producer Tanya Lapointe.

Amazon MGM chief Mike Hopkins characterized Pattinson’s introduction as a milestone for the studio and said the team was intended to usher in a new era of Bond; that is the studio’s stated rationale, not an independently measurable outcome.

explore_lenses.label: How did the search reach Pattinson?
explore_lenses.title: A staged rebuilding of the film team
explore_lenses.summary: The selection followed a multistep rebuild after Craig’s final film, rather than a casting announcement in isolation. Amazon first reorganized control of the property, then appointed producers and a director before confirming its lead actor.

claims.text: Daniel Craig’s five-film Bond run ended with 2021’s No Time to Die; Amazon’s official film guide lists Casino Royale, Quantum of Solace, Skyfall, Spectre and No Time to Die as his entries.
Amazon MGM announced Pascal and Heyman as producers on March 25, 2025, before naming Villeneuve as director on June 25, 2025.

Villeneuve said in 2025 that he viewed Bond as “sacred territory” and intended to honor its tradition while opening a path to future missions; this was his stated creative aspiration before Pattinson was announced.
AP reported that casting director Nina Gold oversaw screen tests and that Pascal and Heyman led the casting process.

story_report.summary: Amazon MGM Studios has named Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond, making him the seventh actor to play the spy and ending the succession question left by Daniel Craig’s departure. Craig completed a five-film run that concluded with 2021’s No Time to Die. Pattinson will lead the next installment under director Denis Villeneuve, with Steven Knight writing the screenplay and Amy Pascal and David Heyman producing.

sections.heading: Amazon MGM’s Bond creative control
sections.body: Amazon MGM gained creative control over future Bond productions through a joint venture that closed in March 2025, while longtime franchise figures Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson remained co-owners of the rights. The studio announced Pascal and Heyman as producers in March 2025, then named Villeneuve as director in June. Amazon MGM chief Mike Hopkins described Pattinson’s casting as the start of a new era for the franchise, a statement of the studio’s ambition rather than a measurable outcome.

sections.heading: Next Bond film remains undefined
sections.body: Amazon MGM has confirmed Villeneuve as director, Knight as screenwriter, Pascal and Heyman as producers, and Tanya Lapointe as executive producer. However, the film has no announced title, production-start date, release date, additional cast, plot or stated theatrical and streaming rollout. The Associated Press reported that shooting is expected to begin in 2027, but Amazon MGM has not confirmed that timetable.

unresolved.text: Amazon MGM has not detailed how its creative control will affect the film’s tone, franchise strategy or release model.
The studio and filmmakers have not publicly described the audition criteria, other finalists or their specific reasons for selecting Pattinson.

related_stories.title: Gérard Depardieu Withdraws Appeal and Apologizes for Sexual Assault Conviction
related_stories.summary: Gérard Depardieu has dropped his appeal against a conviction for sexually assaulting two women on a film set in 2021. In a written statement, the 77-year-old actor acknowledged his guilt and expressed sincere apologies to the victims, stating he had previously hidden behind provocation and humor. The appeal was withdrawn on the day it was scheduled to go to trial.

related_stories.title: US Air Travel Gradually Normalizes After Three-Day Disruption
related_stories.summary: US air travel is gradually returning to normal following three days of significant disruptions caused by a no-takeoff order from aviation authorities. Over the weekend, many passengers faced chaotic conditions at airports, with reports of stranded travelers waiting for updates and rebooking options.

related_stories.title: Nvidia Scandal Highlights US-China AI Rivalry
related_stories.summary: The controversy involving Nvidia and its former CEO Jensen Huang has intensified the focus on the competitive landscape of artificial intelligence between the US and China. Reports of Huang's alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy have further complicated the narrative surrounding Nvidia's advanced chips, which are pivotal in the ongoing AI race.
